title: A day at the beach
instructions: Ben sahilde geçirdiği bir günü anlatıyor. Uzun bir metin; sıraya ve ayrıntılara dikkat et.

script.speaker: ben
script.text: Today is Sunday, and I am at the beach with my friends.

script.speaker: ben
script.text: It is very hot and sunny.

script.speaker: ben
script.text: In the morning, we swim in the sea. The water is warm.

script.speaker: ben
script.text: At one o'clock, we have lunch at a small restaurant. I eat fish and chips.

script.speaker: ben
script.text: In the afternoon, we play volleyball on the sand.

script.speaker: ben
script.text: My friend Ana sits under an umbrella and reads a book. She doesn't like the sun.

script.speaker: ben
script.text: We go home at six o'clock. We are tired but happy.

questions.prompt: What do they do in the morning?
questions.evidence: In the morning, we swim in the sea.

questions.prompt: What does Ben eat for lunch?
questions.feedback: Öğle yemeğinde balık ve patates kızartması yiyor.

questions.prompt: Why does Ana sit under an umbrella?
